commands.command:
mkdir -p /tmp/ansible-inventory-worker && cd /tmp/ansible-inventory-worker && cat > inventory.ini <<'EOF'
[target]
localhost ansible_connection=local
EOF
cat inventory.ini

cat > /tmp/ansible-inventory-worker/playbook.yml <<'EOF'
---
- name: Configure inventory-worker managed service
  hosts: target
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: Create dedicated inventorysvc system group
      group:
        name: inventorysvc
        system: true
        state: present

    - name: Create dedicated inventorysvc system user
      user:
        name: inventorysvc
        group: inventorysvc
        system: true
        shell: /usr/sbin/nologin
        home: /var/lib/inventorysvc
        create_home: true
        state: present

    - name: Ensure os-comparison-worker binary is executable
      file:
        path: /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
        mode: "0755"

    - name: Install inventory-worker systemd unit
      copy:
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=Inventory Worker (os-comparison-worker)
          After=network.target

          [Service]
          Type=simple
          User=inventorysvc
          Group=inventorysvc
          ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
          Restart=on-failure
          RestartSec=5

          [Install]
          WantedBy=multi-user.target
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
      register: unit_file

    - name: Reload systemd daemon
      systemd:
        daemon_reload: true
      when: unit_file.changed

    - name: Enable and start inventory-worker service
      systemd:
        name: inventory-worker
        enabled: true
        state: started
EOF
echo written
